journeys.startingState: A locally bootstrapped repository with the web app available.
expectedBehavior: The application renders its home route without a fatal error.
journeys.oracle: The rendered page contains the expected home content and no fatal runtime error.
nonClaims: Local proof does not establish a deployed provider route.

journeys.startingState: The domain and HTTP API packages are available in-process.
expectedBehavior: The HTTP boundary returns a Schema-decoded domain item list.
preservedInvariants: Unknown ingress decodes at the HTTP boundary.
journeys.oracle: The response passes the owning encoded response Schema and the invalid fixture fails closed.
nonClaims: In-process transport proof does not establish a deployed public route.

journeys.startingState: The domain and RPC packages are available in-process.
expectedBehavior: The RPC client invokes the Schema-owned operation through its handler Layer.
preservedInvariants: The handler delegates to the domain service without a raw client escape hatch.
journeys.oracle: The client result passes the owning response Schema and the invalid fixture fails closed.
nonClaims: In-process RPC proof does not establish deployed network reachability.

journeys.actorOrConsumer: Cooper through an MCP OAuth client
journeys.boundary: Google OAuth through Cloudflare Access to the Instapaper MCP
journeys.startingState: The caller has no current MCP grant and is signed in to Google as the configured account owner.
inputs: A fresh OAuth authorisation request for https://instapaper.coopercorbett.com/mcp
expectedBehavior: Cloudflare Access redirects directly to Google and accepts the configured account owner.
The Worker verifies the Access token and repeats the exact-email check before issuing an MCP grant.
expectedSideEffects: The OAuth client may receive a new MCP grant; no Instapaper bookmark is created, edited or deleted.
preservedInvariants: The Access policy and Worker both restrict access to the configured account owner.
Google and Cloudflare client secrets never appear in the browser URL, MCP response or proof record.
journeys.oracle: A fresh Google-authenticated OAuth journey completes and the same client successfully runs instapaper_access_check while Cloudflare readback still shows the exact-email policy.
journeys.authority: The configured Google identity plus the account owner's approved MCP grant
nonClaims: Successful authentication does not approve an Instapaper bookmark write.

journeys.startingState: The caller is authenticated as Cooper and has a bounded list of candidate URLs and titles.
inputs: One to 25 candidates with original URL, intended save URL and title
expectedBehavior: Unread, starred and archived folders are listed and matching URL or title variants are returned.
expectedSideEffects: No Instapaper bookmark is created, edited or deleted.
preservedInvariants: Unknown input is decoded before the Effect service runs.
Article text and credentials never appear in the result.
journeys.oracle: The result names all tested folder classes and deterministic fixtures catch canonical URL and title variants while the write observation remains empty.
journeys.environment: local contract test, then provider-verified Worker
nonClaims: A duplicate check does not prove an article can be extracted or saved.

journeys.actorOrConsumer: Cooper through an interactive Codex task
journeys.startingState: Cooper approved one exact article and complete marker-free HTML is available.
inputs: Approved canonical and saved URLs, title, description, source tag, length tag, HTML and source word count
expectedBehavior: The duplicate check repeats immediately before add.
The save reports verified only after metadata, tags and get_text readback pass.
expectedSideEffects: Exactly one approved bookmark may be created.
preservedInvariants: A pre-existing bookmark is never deleted or replaced.
Truncation markers fail before the add request.
journeys.oracle: A verified receipt contains the returned bookmark ID and a readback word count of at least 70 percent of source words with zero truncation markers.
journeys.environment: provider-verified Worker and Instapaper Full API
journeys.authority: Cooper approval for the exact article
nonClaims: No live save is approved by repository build or deployment alone.
